# shadcn-admin source boundary

No template source has been copied yet. Features import repository-owned wrappers from `src/components/ui` and `src/components/layout`. Before adapting source from [satnaing/shadcn-admin](https://github.com/satnaing/shadcn-admin), pin a commit and record its SHA-256, adapted files, dependencies, and MIT license/copyright notice in `vendor-manifest.json`. The upstream application uses Vite; this ERP remains a Next.js application.
